ةﻮﻄﺨﺑ ةﻮﻄﺧ ..ﻚﺘﯾاﺮﻗ ﻲﻓPARAGRAPHS · UNIT 1 The Importance of Holidays
Due to the excessive stress and monotonous rhythm of life that we live, we find the fact
that we go on a holiday is becoming more and more necessary. The definition of a
holiday is to cut with the daily routine. So it's not necessarily travelling to another
country and staying in a luxurious hotel; it can be a good holiday even when we stay in
our country: we may arrange parties with friends and enjoy having long weekends in
different places in our country, where we fancy swimming in the clean blue sea and
sunbathing on our sandy golden beaches. Added to that, because we don't have
enough time during the academic year to visit our relatives, the holidays will be a good
opportunity to strengthen the family bonds. Moreover, it's also an occasion to practise
our hobbies like playing music, sport, surfing the net, painting, dancing, etc., since it's
difficult to do that with the amount of homework that we have to do during the school
year. Thus, even when we stay in our country, we can have a good holiday.
In fact, having nice moments isn't necessarily being outside the frontiers of our
country, because we may travel and spend a great deal of money without finding the
pleasure that we look for.
